text_block_list.text:
Summer camp ends in the blink of an
eye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun has worked extremely
hard.

text_block_list.name: Bus Driver
text_block_list.text: We have arrived at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since she worked so hard this summer, it
only
feels fair to let her rest a little
longer.
